phase: Build API-independent catalog, offer, price-history, and ranking foundations

task_envelope.objective: Build source-agnostic catalog foundations that can be exercised before merchant APIs are available.
known_facts: Existing product links already represent merchant offers.
External API credentials and partner contracts are not available.
No real merchant response or production data was used.
Ranking weights are caller-supplied and no commercial default was embedded.
unknowns_preserved: Raw price, currency, availability, rating, demand, and referral data
Partner-specific confirmation, reversal, and settlement rules
stop_conditions: Do not activate an adapter without current partner documentation and approval.
Do not infer missing offer fields or default unavailable products to in-stock.
Do not claim local fixture tests prove partner or production capability.

implementation.ranking_contract: Caller supplies normalized 0..1 feature values and weights totaling 100; equal scores use stable offer ID ordering.
implementation.comparison_preview: Public price-first snapshot comparison using labelled local synthetic fixtures; unknown values remain unavailable and outbound checkout remains external.
implementation.source_adapter_boundary: Generic ProductSourceAdapter contract only; no partner adapter or credential is active.
implementation.financial_feature_switches: Comparison preview rewards, vouchers, and gifts are disabled by default; legacy signed financial endpoints are unchanged.

verification.pilot_gate: blocked as expected; 32 required fields and 4 owner sign-offs pending

scope_completed: Added source-tagged timestamped offer snapshots with nullable unknown fields.
Added latest and source-filtered history access.
Added validation for ratings, discounts, numeric values, and metadata shape.
Added deterministic ranking primitives without embedded commercial weights.
Added local feature tests, guarded synthetic preview seeder, generic adapter boundary, and foundation documentation.
scope_not_completed: No merchant API adapter was activated.
No scraping or unapproved feed ingestion was implemented.
No production, staging, financial, voucher, gift, or partner mutation was performed.
No final ranking weights, live partner source, real reward, voucher, gift, or user-facing commercial activation policy was selected.
open_blockers: Partner APIs/network access and current data-permission terms are still required before source adapters.
limitations: Local fixtures demonstrate application behavior only and do not establish merchant data quality, API limits, attribution, settlement, or production capacity.
